title: Bloomberg's $1B gift to Johns Hopkins made medical tuition free for families earning under $300K
summary_full: In a groundbreaking move, Johns Hopkins University revealed a $1 billion contribution from Bloomberg Philanthropies to significantly improve financial assistance for graduate students. This generous funding extends free tuition to medical students from households earning under $300,000, while those from families with incomes up to $175,000 can access support for both tuition and living expenses.
